kypExtensions.summary: The three-diseases-as-three-stations model (BTK = early cut with absent B cells; IgA deficiency = class-specific switch cut with intact lineage; CVID = late differentiation cut with B cells present), plus the age/B-cell-count/Ig-pattern diagnostic triad and the management bridges (IVIG replacement, washed blood products, IgG-based celiac testing, CVID surveillance).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source lists three diseases without the assembly-line frame or the management logic; these integrations are KYP's design. Management specifics (IVIG, washed products, surveillance programs) are labeled extension.
